name: Crop Protection

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Trigger An enemy within your reach attacks a member of your crop.

---
While you prefer to keep a low profile, you are quick to attack to protect your crop. Make a melee Strike against the triggering enemy. If your attack is successful, the member of your crop gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
